original_scope.retrieval: Complete selected current levels retained under the 314 original-source manifest; no actual game state read.

name_mapping.basic: BWIKI revision 352021 explicit tileKey rows; PRTS basic terrain revision 428351 independently describes names and static terrain labels.
name_mapping.fence_bound: PRTS wall revision 428434 names it 围墙; BWIKI revision 352021 calls tile_fence_bound 围栏. Both retained; code uses 围墙 and states the difference.
name_mapping.ftstart: BWIKI revision 352021 explicitly lists tile_ftstart as 侵入点（假）. The decoder calls it 假侵入点, does not apply its dynamic conversion.
name_mapping.pollution_roadf: Targeted exact-key searches did not establish this precise suffix. It remains a named unknown category, never substituted with tile_pollution_road, tile_toxic or similarly named source-stone pollution.

parameter_evidence.medical: BWIKI directly ties HP_RECOVERY_PER_SEC_BY_MAX_HP_RATIO to maximum-HP recovery per second. Captured PRTS search excerpt explicitly multiplies the numeric ratio by 100 for percent display. The 314 actual 灵魂归宿 original stores 0.03.
parameter_evidence.infection: BWIKI directly ties damage to true damage per second, duration to seconds, atk to attack proportion and attack_speed to additive game attack-speed units. Captured PRTS search excerpt explicitly formats atk * 100 percent.
parameter_evidence.force: BWIKI and captured PRTS template tie base_force_level to additional push/pull force levels; noninteger levels remain uninterpreted.
parameter_evidence.volcano: BWIKI and captured PRTS template tie damage to each eruption true damage and cd_min/cd_max to interval bounds in seconds. The decoder never derives initial eruption or global time.
parameter_evidence.precision: Display preserves supplied finite decimal values, without emulating a wiki template integer-format truncation or asserting engine damage rounding.

implementation_boundaries: Pure single-tile decoder; caller must bind original mapData.tiles declaration to the correct current stage and grid cell.
Names/effects are documentary reference, not current deployment qualification, trigger success, first tick, refresh, damage, immunity or final operator panel.
Only explicit finite real int/float values with no conflicting string representation; booleans, strings, missing, duplicate or ambiguous parameters stay unknown.
No borrowed stage defaults, cross-tile data, rune effects, callback execution, door pairing, inferred path, probability, map calibration, live game sampling or run-state write.
No numerical effect is applied to the calculator. Legend colors are UI choices, not color measurements.
Parameter search excerpt is cached search evidence with unknown origin revision, never represented as full downloaded source; origin challenge and TLS failures retained.
